steps.question: Do the 120 whole-blood samples show outliers or structure beyond case vs control, and what is the variance-stabilized expression matrix that the co-expression network will be built on?

qc_sample_structure: transform = vst_blind (blind=TRUE)

steps.description: Load /eval-four-models-v2-with-coexpression-n60-s1-1/data/inputs/counts/counts.csv (12,000 genes x 120 sample columns) and /eval-four-models-v2-with-coexpression-n60-s1-1/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv (120 rows, sample id + condition). steps.name: Low-count gene filter
caveats: An alternative permitted filter is the fixed rule of at least 10 counts in at least 60 samples (the smallest group size); if filterByExpr retains an implausibly small or large gene set, report both counts
steps.context: Genes with near-zero counts produce correlations driven by noise, which inflates spurious modules. The filter is applied to the counts; the matrix carried forward is the VST of the surviving genes.
steps.question: Which of the 12,000 genes carry enough counts across the 120 whole-blood samples to enter the co-expression network?

grounding.reason: Population-scale cohort (60 per group): filterByExpr with the condition as group before the network, per R-0058@99e1; the fixed 10-counts-in-60-samples rule of R-0002@087b is the named alternative.

constraints: filter_low_counts: filter = filterByExpr
Apply the filter to the raw counts, not to the VST values; carry the resulting gene set over to the VST matrix
Do not additionally subset to a fixed number of most-variable genes — the question asks which modules the genes form, and a top-N variance pre-selection would change the module structure
steps.description: On the raw counts from T1S1, apply edgeR::filterByExpr with group = condition (case/control from metadata.csv) to identify genes with worthwhile expression. steps.name: Signed WGCNA network, modules and eigengene-status association
caveats: A module is a set of correlated genes, not a proven pathway; a module-trait correlation is an association in this cohort only
With ~12,000 genes before filtering, blockwise construction is unnecessary — build the single-block network so the topological overlap is exact

In whole blood, a module tracking case status is very commonly a cell-composition shift (neutrophil, lymphocyte, platelet, erythrocyte content) rather than a within-cell regulatory change; this must be flagged, not glossed
If a module eigengene correlates strongly with log library size, treat its status association as confounded and say so
steps.context: 120 samples is a comfortable cohort size for WGCNA (well above the ~15-20 minimum), so module estimates should be reasonably stable, but the module-trait correlations remain associations within this one cohort. Single batch, so no batch covariate is available or needed; log library size stands in as the technical covariate.
steps.question: Which co-expression modules do the filtered genes form across the 120 whole-blood samples, and which module eigengenes correlate with case versus control status?

grounding.reason: Co-expression question on a 120-sample count dataset: signed WGCNA on the variance-stabilized filtered matrix, soft threshold by scale-free fit, eigengenes correlated with the case/control trait, hubs by kME, per R-0139@0008.

constraints: coexpression: network_type = signed
coexpression: soft_threshold_criterion = scale_free_fit_index_0.8
coexpression: module_detection = topological_overlap_dynamic_tree_cut
coexpression: hub_ranking = module_membership_kME
coexpression: min_module_size = 30
coexpression: merge_cut_height = 0.25
Build the network on the variance-stabilized values from T1S2, not on raw or CPM counts
Set enableWGCNAThreads or allowWGCNAThreads consistently and disable the stringsAsFactors trap as the WGCNA vignette requires
Report the grey module explicitly as unassigned genes rather than treating it as a biological module
steps.description: Build a signed weighted co-expression network with WGCNA on the filtered VST matrix from T1S2 (samples x genes, 120 samples). Steps: (1) pickSoftThreshold over a power grid with networkType='signed'; choose the lowest power at which the scale-free topology fit index R^2 reaches ~0.8, and report the chosen power, its fit index and the mean connectivity — if no power reaches 0.8, say so and use the WGCNA default for a signed network at n=120 (power 12), stating that the scale-free criterion was not met. (2) Build the adjacency and the topological overlap matrix, cluster, and cut with cutreeDynamic (deepSplit default, minModuleSize=30). (3) Compute module eigengenes, merge modules whose eigengenes correlate above 1-0.25 (mergeCutHeight=0.25), and report module count and sizes before and after merging. (4) Compute kME (module membership) for every gene in every module and emit the full gene-to-module table with kME. (5) Correlate each module eigengene with the case/control trait coded 0/1, using Pearson correlation with its p-value, and additionally test each eigengene against condition with a two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test as a distribution-free check. Adjust p-values with Benjamini-Hochberg across all modules. (6) Also correlate each eigengene with log library size from T1S1 as a technical covariate, so that a module tracking depth rather than status is visible. Set and record a random seed. Emit: soft-threshold diagnostic plot, module dendrogram with color bands, module-trait heatmap, eigengene boxplots by condition for the significant modules, and the gene-to-module-with-kME table.
acceptance_criteria: Soft-threshold power is chosen by the scale-free fit index >= 0.8 rule and reported together with the fit index and mean connectivity; failure to reach 0.8 is stated explicitly if it occurs
Network is signed and modules come from dynamic tree cut on the topological overlap dendrogram with minModuleSize=30 and mergeCutHeight=0.25
A complete gene-to-module assignment table with per-gene kME is emitted, covering every gene that entered the network including the grey (unassigned) module
Each module eigengene has a correlation with the 0/1 case/control trait, a raw p-value, a Wilcoxon p-value, and a BH-adjusted p-value across modules
Each module eigengene is also correlated with log library size and the result reported alongside the status association
Module count, individual module sizes, the number of samples (120), and the number of genes entering the network are all reported
Random seed and WGCNA version are recorded

steps.name: Hub genes and functional characterization of status-associated modules

steps.context: Enrichment here is interpretation of modules already defined, not a new statistical test of the case/control contrast. The gene universe must be the filtered network gene set, since using a whole-genome background against a 12,000-gene input inflates every enrichment.
steps.question: What biological content do the modules that track case versus control status carry — which genes are their hubs, and which human pathways are over-represented in them?

grounding.reason: The returned procedure covers hub ranking by kME inside the co-expression step but no rule covers a separate over-representation characterization of module gene sets; planned from general practice with the network gene set as background.

constraints: Use the genes that entered the WGCNA network as the enrichment background — do not use a genome-wide default universe
Use a human gene set collection matching the organism (taxon 9606); do not substitute mouse or rat pathway sets
Report the name and version of the gene set collection actually used
Do not run enrichment on the grey (unassigned) module
steps.description: Take the gene-to-module table with kME and the module-trait association table from T3S3. For every module (not only the significant ones), list the top 20 hub genes by kME. Report the pathway, the overlap size, the module size, the raw and BH-adjusted p-values, and the overlapping gene symbols. The identifier space of the count matrix rows is determined and, where mapping is required, the mapping rate to gene symbols is reported
Over-representation results for each status-associated module use the filtered network gene set as the background universe, and this is stated explicitly
Each enrichment result carries overlap size, module size, raw p-value, BH-adjusted p-value and the overlapping genes

steps.name: Co-expression report

steps.context: Final synthesis. The report is where the interpretive limits are stated, not softened.
steps.question: What is the complete, reproducible account of the module structure across the 120 whole-blood samples and of which modules track case versus control status?

grounding.reason: Co-expression report contents per R-0151@c88b and the reproducibility record per R-0086@becf.

constraints: report: reproducibility_record = session_info, seed, package_versions, collection_version, annotation_release

report: coexpression_report = n_samples, n_genes, network_type, soft_threshold_power, scale_free_fit, module_sizes, gene_module_table, module_membership, eigengene_trait_correlations, adjusted_p_values
Do not report a per-gene differential expression result — none was fitted, and the research question did not ask for one
Do not describe a module-status association as a causal or mechanistic finding
steps.description: Assemble the final report from T1S1, T1S2, T3S3 and T3S4. acceptance_criteria: Report states n_samples, n_genes entering the network, network type, soft-threshold power, scale-free fit index and mean connectivity
Module sizes, the full gene-to-module table with kME, and the eigengene-trait correlations with BH-adjusted p-values are all included
Reproducibility record present: sessionInfo, package versions, random seed, gene set collection version and annotation release
The report explicitly states that modules are correlated gene groups rather than proven pathways, and that module-status correlations are cohort-level associations
The report explicitly names unmeasured blood cell composition as an uncontrolled alternative explanation for any status-associated module

plan.title: Whole-blood WGCNA modules vs case/control status
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a single gene-level Salmon count matrix (12,000 genes x 121 columns: 1 gene-id column + 120 samples) with a 120 x 2 sample table giving condition (60 cases, 60 controls), whole blood, human, one batch, unpaired. The research question is purely a co-expression question: which modules the genes form across the 120 samples, and which modules track case vs control. The plan therefore does not fit a per-gene differential expression contrast — that would be unasked scope; the case/control status enters only as the trait correlated against module eigengenes.

Order follows the procedure returned by the knowledge service. T1S1 does sample-structure QC on raw counts with a design-blind VST, PCA on the 500 most variable genes and a sample-distance heatmap — with 120 samples this is where an outlier or an unrecorded structural axis would show, and WGCNA is highly sensitive to outlier samples, so the VST matrix produced here is the substrate for the network. T1S2 applies filterByExpr with the condition as the grouping factor to drop genes with no worthwhile counts; correlations computed on near-zero genes are noise and would inflate module count. T3S3 builds the signed weighted network on the filtered VST matrix: soft-threshold power chosen as the lowest power reaching scale-free fit R^2 >= 0.8, modules from the topological-overlap dendrogram by dynamic tree cut (minModuleSize 30, mergeCutHeight 0.25), then module eigengenes, and correlation of every eigengene with the binary case/control trait plus library size as a technical covariate, BH-adjusted across modules. T3S4 characterizes the modules that track status: hub genes by kME and over-representation of the module gene sets against human pathway gene sets present in the reference store (WikiPathways human is staged), with the filtered gene universe as background. T1S3 assembles the report. Whole blood means cell-composition shifts are a leading alternative explanation for any status-associated module — the report must state that, since a neutrophil- or lymphocyte-dominated module tracking case status is a composition signal, not a regulatory one.

One data caveat drives a check in T1S1: the profile records the counts as Salmon gene-level output without stating whether the length correction was applied. The counts are used only through a VST, so the consequence is bounded, but the step must report whether the matrix is integer or fractional and round if fractional rather than assume.

steps.method: blind VST + PCA + sample distance heatmap
WGCNA signed co-expression network with module eigengenes and module membership

steps.name: Co-expression report
steps.question: What is the complete, reproducible account of the module structure across the 120 whole-blood samples and of which modules track case versus control status?
steps.description: Assemble the final report from T1S1, T1S2, T3S3 and T3S4. It must state: the number of samples (120: 60 cases, 60 controls) and the number of genes entering the network after filtering out of the 12,000 profiled; the network type (signed); the soft-threshold power with its scale-free fit index and mean connectivity; the module detection parameters (minModuleSize 30, mergeCutHeight 0.25); every module with its size and color label; the full gene-to-module table with module membership kME; the correlation of every module eigengene with the case/control trait together with the raw p-value and the p-value adjusted across modules; and the eigengene correlation with log library size. Include the reproducibility record: sessionInfo, package versions, the random seed, and the version of the gene set collection and any annotation resource used in T3S4. State plainly that a module is a group of correlated genes and not a proven pathway, that a module-trait correlation is an association within this cohort, and that in whole blood a status-associated module is frequently a cell-composition signal — no deconvolution was run here, so composition cannot be excluded as the explanation.
steps.context: Final synthesis. The report is where the interpretive limits are stated, not softened.
acceptance_criteria: Report states n_samples, n_genes entering the network, network type, soft-threshold power, scale-free fit index and mean connectivity
Module sizes, the full gene-to-module table with kME, and the eigengene-trait correlations with BH-adjusted p-values are all included
Reproducibility record present: sessionInfo, package versions, random seed, gene set collection version and annotation release
The report explicitly states that modules are correlated gene groups rather than proven pathways, and that module-status correlations are cohort-level associations
The report explicitly names unmeasured blood cell composition as an uncontrolled alternative explanation for any status-associated module
constraints: report: reproducibility_record = session_info, seed, package_versions, collection_version, annotation_release

report: coexpression_report = n_samples, n_genes, network_type, soft_threshold_power, scale_free_fit, module_sizes, gene_module_table, module_membership, eigengene_trait_correlations, adjusted_p_values
Do not report a per-gene differential expression result — none was fitted, and the research question did not ask for one
Do not describe a module-status association as a causal or mechanistic finding
caveats: If the scale-free fit criterion was not met at any power in T3S3, the report must carry that forward as a limitation on module reliability

grounding.reason: Co-expression report contents per R-0151@c88b and the reproducibility record per R-0086@becf.
